name: What kind of caulk is best for exterior window sealing in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What kind of caulk is best for exterior window sealing in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exterior window sealing in the Bay Area, a high-quality, flexible, and durable caulk is essential to withstand varying weather conditions, including fog, rain, and sun exposure. Polyurethane or silicone-based sealants are generally recommended. Polyurethane offers excellent adhesion and flexibility, ideal for wider gaps and harsh conditions. Silicone sealants are highly durable, UV-resistant, and remain flexible over time. Acrylic latex caulk with silicone additives can also be a good option for smaller gaps and painted surfaces, offering a balance of flexibility and paintability.
acceptedAnswer.description: For Bay Area windows, flexible and durable polyurethane or silicone-based caulks are best due to their resistance to varying weather conditions. Acrylic latex with silicone is suitable for smaller gaps.
